description: Step 1: Bayesian window optimization using Optuna TPE. Runs real forward/reverse sieves across 26 GPUs to find optimal window_size, offset, and skip_range parameters.

window_size.description: Size of the temporal window (number of draws) for PRNG matching.
window_size.effect: Short-term temporal regime confirmed (167-trial run S138). TRSE Rule A caps at 32 when short_persistence active. Config ceiling 50 provides buffer. W2 dominant empirically.
window_size._calibration_note: S148 Run-1 ruling: W12 promoted as production default. Bounds [2,50] unchanged — Optuna explores freely.

offset.description: Time offset from current draw position.
offset.effect: Non-zero offset may capture periodic PRNG reseeding patterns.

skip_min.description: Minimum skip value for variable skip PRNG patterns.
skip_min.effect: Controls lower bound of skip range search.

skip_max.description: Maximum skip value for variable skip PRNG patterns.
skip_max.effect: Controls upper bound of skip range search. Higher = more flexibility.

forward_threshold.description: Forward sieve match threshold. Higher = stricter filtering.
forward_threshold.effect: Controls false positive rate in forward sieve.
forward_threshold._note: Bounds are INFORMATIONAL ONLY. Runtime bounds defined in distributed_config.json

reverse_threshold.description: Reverse sieve match threshold. Controls historical consistency.
reverse_threshold._note: Bounds are INFORMATIONAL ONLY. Runtime bounds defined in distributed_config.json

window_trials.description: Number of Optuna trials for window parameter optimization.
window_trials.effect: More trials = better exploration but longer runtime. 50-100 typical.

seed_count.description: Number of candidate seeds to test per trial.
seed_count.effect: More seeds = higher recall but O(n) slower. 10M-100M for testing, 1B+ for production.

search_strategy.description: Optuna search strategy for parameter space exploration.
search_strategy.effect: bayesian (TPE) is most sample-efficient. Use random for quick sanity checks.

test_both_modes.description: Test BOTH constant AND variable skip patterns (V2.0 feature).
test_both_modes.effect: Doubles search space but discovers variable skip patterns.

use_persistent_workers.description: [S130] Use persistent GPU sieve workers (sieve_gpu_worker.py) instead of per-job subprocess launch. Eliminates per-job ROCm init overhead. Requires soak test validation before enabling in production.
use_persistent_workers.effect: Expected 4-5x throughput gain on AMD rigs by keeping ROCm initialized across jobs.

worker_pool_size.description: [S130] Number of persistent worker processes to spawn per AMD rig (1 per GPU). Zeus always uses execute_local_job regardless of this setting.
worker_pool_size.effect: Set to 8 for full rig utilization. Reduce for debugging or partial-rig testing.

seed_cap_nvidia.description: [S129B-A] Max seeds per job chunk for NVIDIA GPUs (RTX 3080 Ti). Measured hardware ceiling ~2.2M sps.
seed_cap_nvidia.effect: Controls chunk sizing for Zeus GPUs. 5M = safe production value at ~2.2M sps measured throughput.

seed_cap_amd.description: [S129B-A] Max seeds per job chunk for AMD GPUs (RX 6600). Measured hardware ceiling ~787k sps.
seed_cap_amd.effect: Controls chunk sizing for rig GPUs. 2M = safe production value at ~788k sps measured throughput.

seed_start.description: [S140] Starting seed for search range. Set automatically by WATCHER coverage tracker to advance into unexplored seed space. Manual override allowed.

use_range_miner.description: [S172 Phase 1] Enable RANGE-MINER stripe backend. Mutually exclusive with use_persistent_workers and use_zmq_sqlite. Phase 1 is scaffolding-only: setting true will raise NotImplementedError until Phases 2-5 land. Do not enable in production until Phase 7 acceptance completes.
use_range_miner.effect: Replaces chunk-dispatch Step 1 with miner-style long-lived GPU daemons (v1.4.4 §3).

miner_stripe_size.description: [S172 §6.2] Seeds per stripe per GPU. Default 64M. Used only when use_range_miner=true.

miner_substripes.description: [S172 §6.2] Sub-stripe count per stripe. Default 8 (sized to fit lockup_timeout=30000). Used only when use_range_miner=true.

miner_output_dir.description: [S172 Phase 1, infra-neutral] Miner NPZ output directory. null = auto: /dev/shm/prng/miner/ if writable (LXC ramdisk-bind case), else ~/miner_output/ (VM/bare metal). Explicit path overrides auto-detect. Used only when use_range_miner=true.

study_name.description: Optuna study DB name to resume (e.g. 'window_opt_1772507547'). Empty = auto-select most recent incomplete study.

use_zmq_sqlite.description: S158D: Use ZMQ+SQLite coordinator instead of PWC. Eliminates persistent SSH pipes. Workers launched once per run, pull jobs via ZMQ TCP.

staging_workers.description: [S172-BP] Bounded staging-executor size. Beta did NOT rule a new number — 'tune after measurement'; this is today's value made REACHABLE, not a retune.

staging_queue_depth.description: [S172-BP] Extra staging admission slots beyond the executor size. The staging admission bound is (staging_workers + staging_queue_depth) — 6 today.

staging_deferred_max.description: [S172-BP] OPERATOR OVERRIDE of the DERIVED deferred-queue bound (conservative burst + resume margin, sized from the resolved execution set, stripe geometry, phase and per-worker VRAM seed caps). null = derived, which is the production shape and the reason the old constant 64 was deleted. A value BELOW the derived bound logs a WARNING naming both numbers. NOTE: WATCHER skips null-valued params when building the command, so null emits no flag — which is exactly the intended 'use the derivation' behaviour.

staging_capacity_timeout.description: [S172-BP §1.5] Bounded wait in seconds, measured from the OLDEST paused connection's pause-entry time, after which the trial terminates with a coordinator_staging_capacity_timeout reason via a DIRECT fail_trial — never the phase-specific worker retry matrix. Same class as staging_timeout; the default is FLAGGED FOR BETA.

resume_checkpoint.description: [S172 D6.2] Canonical 24-field accumulator checkpoint to resume. THE VALUE IS A CHECKPOINT RUN ID, never a path: a single opaque component matching [A-Za-z0-9._-]+, resolved only beneath .s172_checkpoint/<run_id>/. Empty = no resume. Must be declared HERE or WATCHER's step-scoped filter (watcher_agent.py:1312) drops the key before the command is built. Requires resume_study=true.
